segments.mature: One reviewer, 41 and dealing with hormonal acne, reports calmer skin and a more even tone after two days of use.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with hormonal acne describes redness that hurt being calmed after using the pads twice daily.

concerns.spots: Reports are mixed: two reviewers say dark spots faded, one within a week and nearly gone after a month, while two others report no visible change in their dark spots or scars after weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with hormonal acne on the cheeks reports calming of active breakouts and reduced redness; another reviewer using it for acne scars reports no breakout issues from the product itself but also no scar improvement.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the pads leave her face very oily throughout the night.
concerns.redness: One reviewer describes painful redness from hormonal acne being calmed after starting use.
concerns.aging: No reviewer reports on aging-specific effects such as fine lines or firmness beyond one mature reviewer's general skin-calming and brightening results.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer reports on barrier-specific effects like irritation or compromised skin.
concerns.dehydration: No reviewer reports on hydration or dryness outcomes from this product.
